_comment: Server content: reward catalog. icon = column in assets/ui/shop_icons.png. Epic and legendary purchases need manual approval. weekly_stock = items per week, refilled every Monday, 0 = unlimited (the admin overrides it in the panel). Prices follow docs/economy.md: common about a day of tasks, rare 2-3 days, epic 1.5-2 weeks, legendary about two months. Merch also unlocks matching wardrobe items (see wardrobe.json); such customization is bought or won only once.
